def extract_grid(txt, label, h, w):
    pat=label+r'\n((?:[0-9 ]+\n){'+str(h)+'})'
    m=re.search(pat,txt)
    if not m: raise ValueError(label)
    rows=[[int(x) for x in line.split()] for line in m.group(1).strip().splitlines()]
    assert len(rows)==h and all(len(r)==w for r in rows)
    return rows
pairs=[]
for idx,(h,w) in enumerate([(26,26),(24,24)], start=1):
    t=usertexts[idx]
    gi=extract_grid(t,rf'Demo pair {idx} input \({h}x{w}\):',h,w)
    go=extract_grid(t,rf'Demo pair {idx} output \({h}x{w}\):',h,w)
    pairs.append((gi,go))
print([(len(a),len(b)) for a,b in pairs])
